what: Per-claim outcomes of the E020 model-driven sittings, as read by T40 (tools/check_counts.py refuses `corroborated` unless the claim's own per-arm rule holds, and every rule refuses net observations).
limit: The watcher takes a frame about every 1.4 s and the computer plays several exchanges in that time, so two frames hold the net of one or more exchanges, never one known to be single. The reader therefore records what it finds as net observations (`net:seq`), not exchanges: tools/check_counts.py counts them apart and every claim rule refuses them whatever its floors (T40 round 2, R1). The three sittings give 0 exchanges and 55 net observations; in none of the 55 was one army lost in all, and a defender of one army never appears in one, because its loss is a capture. Single exchanges need a faster capture (a later task, the owner's decision of 2026-10-09).
